# Playback / transport smoke (Linux desktop, drive.py)
#
# Purpose: verify the live app is responsive to core transport actions:
#   play/pause toggle, next/prev skip, and fast-forward (seek).
#
# Requires: short test tones staged under `.tmp/` on the target host and
# passed here as absolute paths. Edit the paths below to match your checkout.
# Example tones (used by existing playback.txt):
#   t1_a440_2s.wav, t2_c554_2s.wav, t3_e659_2s.wav, t5_a880_2s.wav, long_10s.wav
+
+# Set a deterministic queue (autoplay should start on setQueue).
+call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t1_a440_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t2_c554_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t3_e659_2s.wav startIndex=0
+
+inspect
+
+# play/pause toggle
+pause
+inspect
+resume
+inspect
+
+# skip
+next
+inspect
+prev
+inspect
+
+# fast-forward (seek within the current track)
+# (seek accepts milliseconds or mm:ss / hh:mm:ss)
+seek 00:00:01
+inspect
+
+# Optional: next after seek
+next
+inspect
+

# Playback / transport smoke (Linux desktop, drive.py)
#
# Purpose: verify the live app is responsive to core transport actions:
#   play/pause toggle, next/prev skip, and fast-forward (seek).
#
# Requires: short test tones staged under `.tmp/` on the target host and
# passed here as absolute paths. Edit the paths below to match your checkout.
# Example tones (used by existing playback.txt):
#   t1_a440_2s.wav, t2_c554_2s.wav, t3_e659_2s.wav, t5_a880_2s.wav, long_10s.wav
+
+# Set a deterministic queue (autoplay should start on setQueue).
+call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t1_a440_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t2_c554_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t3_e659_2s.wav startIndex=0
+
+inspect
+
+# play/pause toggle
+pause
+inspect
+resume
+inspect
+
+# skip
+next
+inspect
+prev
+inspect
+
+# fast-forward (seek within the current track)
+# (seek accepts milliseconds or mm:ss / hh:mm:ss)
+seek 00:00:01
+inspect
+
+# Optional: next after seek
+next
+inspect
+
